description: This file contains a collection of bash functions and script snippets that implement an API for managing system services using procd in OpenWRT. It includes functions for opening, closing, configuring, and controlling services and their instances, as well as utilities for system interactions like locking, signals, and configuration validation.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service with a given name and optional script, preparing for subsequent configuration and management.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Finalizes the service setup and sends the configuration to system via ubus.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Opens a new instance of a service with an optional name, used to configure specific instances.

methods.name: procd_close_instance
methods.description: Closes the current service instance, completing its configuration.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a specific service or its instance is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or specific instance.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a specific signal to a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of a service or instance, such as running or stopped.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data object for a service, used for nested data.

methods.name: procd_close_data
methods.description: Closes the data object previously opened.

methods.name: procd_set_param
methods.description: Configures parameters of various types (environment, commands, files, limits, etc.) for a service instance.

methods.name: procd_append_param
methods.description: Appends additional parameters to existing service configurations.

methods.name: procd_add_validation
methods.description: Adds validation routines to a configuration.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Signals that the configuration has changed for a particular package.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns_service
methods.description: Defines an mDNS service with specified properties.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Adds mDNS configuration for the system.
